MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card fits my repeated use of microSD cards and adapters; a familiar 32GB card makes sense as spare storage for compatible devices.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables support the accessories I already use, especially my card reader, by adding connection space and reach.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my TV setup, although 4K capability itself adds little for my 720p screen."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show and larger Fire tablet overlap with screen tasks my Fire 7 already handles, without addressing a current need to replace it.",
    "My camera tripods, lens cap, and memory cards support photography; they do not indicate that I want doorbells or home security cameras.",
    "The Ethernet pack solves a different connection problem from my USB accessories, while the smart speaker and earbuds lack a clear connection to anything I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, even when their functions do not help my existing setup.",
    "Broad similarities such as being a cable, camera, or electronic device seem to count too much compared with the specific task the item serves."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of cards, readers, holders, mounts, and cables suggest that making existing equipment easier to use matters to me.",
    "Connection type, compatible device, cable length, and pack size affect whether an accessory is useful; six one-foot Ethernet cables do not meet the same need as a USB extension.",
    "Having a tablet with its case and mount makes another tablet less compelling unless there is a clear reason to upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in practical accessories but stretched ownership of electronics into interest in unrelated devices and unnecessary upgrades."
}
